en.summary: PM Spajić's government aims to close talks in 2026, sign the accession treaty in 2027 and join the EU in 2028 ('28th member by '28'). All 33 chapters are open and 18 are provisionally closed. Its 'Euro Model' reforms aim to stop emigration and raise living standards.
